in_marathi.name: Gomateshwara
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Elephant God Ganesha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gomateshwara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gomateshwara is a compound name derived from the words 'Goma' (cow) and 'Ishwara' (God). This name is revered for the Lord of the Elephant God, Ganesha. In Hindu mythology, Lord Ganesha is known to be the remover of obstacles and the god of wisdom and knowledge. The name Gomateshwara signifies the divine power and blessings of Lord Ganesha.
